title: PR 181 overlay: the selection overlay controller keeps itself in sync with the render view
context: SelectionOverlay handle types and endpoints were refreshed only when NoteTouchSelection called update(), so handle drags, the Android copy collapse and Select All left handles in the old selection's shape. The render view (not a PR file) exposes no selection listenable, and a handle drag could also carry its end past the other end.
options: call update() after each known change site
take a selection ValueListenable from the host
check the render view's selection and layout after each frame while handles or the toolbar are showing
outcome: A post-frame check that runs only while handles or the toolbar are showing. It compares the selection and the layout identity and calls update() only on a change, and it schedules no frames (commit 8c277c4). Handle drags also refuse to reach or cross the other end on every platform, not only Android and Fuchsia, because RenderNoteView always places the start and end links at selection start and end (commit 5719d67).
